blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) is eyeing the P3-trillion collection mark before the end of November––a goal that it plans to achieve through stronger tax compliance. On Thursday, the BIR said in a statement that it collected P2.8 trillion in the first 10 months, up 5.63 percent from the comparable period in 2025. READ: DOF stands pat on BIR, BOC collection targets In October alone, revenues grew by nearly 6 percent to P348.5 billion.
